mentions.name: 2D Zelda-style adventure MMO
mentions.description: A 2D top-down Zelda-style adventure MMO game built as a persistent world with Minecraft-like building and procedurally generated quests, focused on co-op adventuring and social play rather than PvP. A personal tinker project not aimed at a releasable state.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m working on a 2D top-down Zelda-style adventure MMO game. I’m imagining it as a persistent world with Minecraft-like building and procedurally generated quests. I’d like to focus on co-op adventuring and social rather than pvp.
